visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women, one in a denim jacket over a beige hoodie and another in a black jacket, stand in a bright, white-walled indoor space, smiling and waving at the camera. Their facial expressions are joyful, and they make peace signs with their hands. The lighting is even and flat. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a cramped, colorful retail store. Shelves are overflowing with pink and pastel-colored plush toys, specifically Hello Kitty and My Melody characters. The background lighting is warm and incandescent, illuminating dozens of small accessories and stationery items. (3) Close-up shots of various Hello Kitty plushies in different outfits are presented. A hand with a ring is seen touching a denim-clad plushie hanging on a rack. The background shows a glass display case containing rare collectibles and a cluttered shop environment. (4) A hand holds a pink plastic cup decorated with cartoon animals to show the camera. In the background, stacks of pink boxes and various Sanrio-themed household items are visible under bright indoor lights. The woman in the foreground is seen laughing. (5) The two women stand together, one holding a pile of plastic-wrapped purchases. They are smiling broadly at the camera while speaking. The background is filled with racks of clothing and more plushies, creating a dense, visually stimulating environment. (6) A woman with short hair walks quickly down a brightly lit hallway carrying two large, white shopping bags with gold polka dots. She looks happy and triumphant. Cardboard boxes are stacked against the pink-walled shop entrance behind her. (7) The final shots show the exterior of Xinyi Anhe Station exit 2A and a colorful 'Sanrio Happy Holidays' sign on an easel outside the shop entrance. The sky is overcast and the street lighting is natural daylight.

The background features a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar and piano melody with a steady, moderate tempo. The vocals are clear with high pitch variability, expressing excitement. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect marks the transition as they enter the shop. The upbeat music continues. One woman's voice rises significantly in pitch as she describes the cute items on the shelves. Subtle rustling sounds of plastic packaging are audible. (3) The speech remains rapid and highly energetic as they browse. The two voices overlap slightly as they discuss specific products. A rhythmic 'whoosh' sound effect is heard during a quick transition. The music stays consistent and cheerful. (4) The tone becomes briefly nostalgic as one speaker mentions childhood memories, accompanied by a slight decrease in volume but maintaining positive valence. The background music swells slightly during this moment of focus. (5) Loud laughter and playful banter between the two women dominate the audio. A soft thudding sound is heard as shopping bags are handled. The video concludes with a cheerful sign-off and the background music fading out.
